otp.errorInvalid: The OTP is invalid or has expired.
otp.errorResend: Unable to resend the OTP. Please try again later.
otp.hint: The code usually arrives within about 1 minute. Don't see the email? Check your Spam/Promotions folder too. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

section.title: Rental contract
section.empty: No contract for this booking yet (one is usually created and sent for signing on approval).
section.emptyCreateSuffix: If it is missing, you can create and send it for signing right here.
section.emptyNotCreatableSuffix: A contract can only be created once the booking is approved (Approved) or after the renter has paid the deposit.
section.noteOnlyApproved: A contract can only be created once the booking is approved and no contract is currently active.
section.pinSetupDescription: Create a 6-digit PIN to open and download the rental contract. You only need to enter it once per login session.
section.pinViewDescription: Enter your PIN to open contract {{number}} (v{{version}}). OTP is only sent by email when signing a contract.
section.pinDownloadDescription: Enter your PIN to download the PDF of contract {{number}} (v{{version}}). OTP is only sent by email when signing a contract.
section.otpDescription: The OTP to sign the contract has been sent to your email. Signing via OTP is legally valid, just like a handwritten signature.
section.otpDescriptionWithContract: The OTP to sign contract {{number}} (v{{version}}) has been sent to your email. Signing via OTP is legally valid, just like a handwritten signature.

extend.title: Extend contract
extend.description: Extending creates a new version (v{{version}}) with a later return date. The new version is pending signature and both parties must sign again via OTP. The extension fee is based on the current contract's average daily price and is added to the total value.
extend.invalid: Please enter an extension of 1 to 90 days.

extensionRequest.title: Request contract extension
extensionRequest.description: Send an extension request to the vehicle owner. If the owner approves, the system checks the vehicle schedule and creates a new contract version for both parties to sign again via OTP.
extensionRequest.notePlaceholder: e.g. I need the car for a few more days for a business trip...
extensionRequest.invalid: Please enter an extension of 1 to 90 days.
extensionRequest.failed: Could not send the extension request.
extensionRequest.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. The car is already booked by another customer on these days...
extensionRequest.rejectRequired: Please enter a reason for rejection.
extensionRequest.rejectFailed: Could not reject the extension request.
extensionRequest.pendingOwner: The renter requested an extension of {{count}} more days
extensionRequest.approveHint: Approving checks the vehicle schedule and creates a new contract version for both parties to sign again.
extensionRequest.pendingCustomer: Your request to extend by {{count}} more days is awaiting the vehicle owner's approval
extensionRequest.approvedInfo: The {{count}}-day extension request was approved. The new contract version is awaiting signatures from both parties.
extensionRequest.rejectedInfo: The {{count}}-day extension request was rejected by the vehicle owner
extensionRequest.sentToastMessage: The request to extend by {{count}} days has been sent to the vehicle owner.
extensionRequest.approvedToastMessage: A new contract version for the {{count}}-day extension has been created. Both parties need to sign again via OTP.
extensionRequest.approveFailedMessage: Could not approve the extension request.
extensionRequest.rejectedToastMessage: The extension request has been rejected.
